objects.taxonomy_description: Bowed stringed instrument with a curved wooden body approximately 35 cm long. Body has an hourglass shape with C-bouts (inward curves) on each side. Top plate (soundboard) is spruce with two f-shaped sound holes. Back plate is maple with a distinctive flame pattern.
